requireActiveSelection.description:
Whether or not one action in this group must be selected at all times. Determines the behavior of what happens
when the selected action is clicked. If {@link UiSdlBaseDataGridToggleableTableActionGroup#requireActiveSelection}
is true, nothing will happen. If false, the selection is unselected.
If true, one {@link UiSdlBaseDataGridSelectableTableAction} in the group should be initialized with
{@link UiSdlBaseDataGridSelectableTableAction#selected} set to true. If none is specified, the first will be selected.

title:
A group of table actions where only one action can be selected at a time. When actions are toggled,
{@link UiSdlBaseDataGrid#triggerToggleSelectedTableAction} is triggered. Actions that are specified in a
{@link UiSdlBaseDataGridToggleableTableActionGroup} will have their selection state reflected in the UI.
name: UiSdlBaseDataGridToggleableTableActionGroup
